rules.objective: Put out the fire: step away from the flame and into open ground, then recover health
A projectile is inbound: break the straight line to it (move sideways or behind cover) instead of standing still
Step off the magma block: it burns through boots and health is not worth the shortcut
Move away from the fire next to you before continuing
Keep distance from the flames while working in this area
Look away from the enderman and walk off: holding its gaze in the Nether or the End starts a fight the bot cannot win
Do not linger next to a spawner: light it up or leave, otherwise the mobs keep coming
Get out of the lava immediately: move to solid ground and heal before anything else.
Wait for the automatic respawn, then recover the dropped items.
Escape immediate danger and recover health before resuming progression.
Recover health immediately: avoid every fight, eat if food is available and move to safety.
Move away from the creeper before it explodes: do not fight it in melee.
Find or craft something safe to eat before continuing with the objective.
Eat available food to restore hunger before resuming progression.
Surface for air before the air budget runs out.
Riding the waterfall: stay inside the column until the landing pool, then step out of the water before mining or digging
Move away from the lava and keep at least four blocks of distance.
Deal with the hostile mob that is within melee range.
Recover health when convenient: eat if hungry and avoid unnecessary combat.
Reach safety before dark: shelter in place, dig in, or get inside walls.
Sleep in the nearby bed to skip the dangerous night.
Eat before hunger starts to hurt.
